episodes.definition: maximal consecutive settlements with the same extreme Funding direction
episodes.labels: first canonical 1m open strictly after settlement; frozen latest fully closed 1H ATR

market_state_attribution.source: frozen latest fully closed 1H regime from the existing classifier
market_state_attribution.support_rule: SUPPORTED only if one broad frozen state or Funding side has positive 4h and 8h signed medians in both Early and Late, and a distinct state or side consistently accounts for the opposite observations; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_MECHANISM

h22.statement: Extreme settled-funding episode onset contains contrarian directional information after removing repeated same-tail settlements.
h22.support: 4h/8h signed medians >0; weekly bootstrap p05 >=-0.05; real-minus-permutation >0; Early/Late >0; LONG/SHORT >=-0.05
h22.falsify: both signed medians <=0 or both permutation deltas <=0

h23.statement: Early/Late instability is attributable to reproducible frozen market-state or side asymmetry rather than arbitrary calendar drift.

interaction_common.funding: latest settled non-stale extreme using frozen v0.3.7 direction
interaction_common.reference: original event close and frozen 15m ATR
interaction_common.controls: non-pattern trend-regime decisions, same year/15m ATR decile/Funding side, >=24h, K=5 nearest, reuse allowed
interaction_common.support: 4h/8h pooled signed medians and matched deltas >0; signed bootstrap p05 >=-0.05; Early/Late >0; LONG/SHORT >=-0.05
interaction_common.falsify: both pooled signed medians <=0 or both matched deltas <=0

h24.statement: Funding direction on frozen TP_PATTERN internally replicates.
h24.evidence_status: post-hoc-inspired Development internal replication, not pristine OOS

h25.statement: Funding direction on frozen BR_PATTERN internally replicates as a preregistered negative comparison.

movement_reproduction: descriptive H21 smoke only; no directional verdict substitution
